tagline: Breathy flute voice from noise and a tuned delay
description: A four-voice instrument that sends filtered pink noise through a feedback delay line tuned to the note, giving a breathy, flute-like tone. It is a simple delay-line resonator rather than a full physical model of the bamboo tube. Use it for airy lead lines and textures.

features.name: Breath Pressure
features.description: Sets how much noise drives the resonator and how bright that noise is.

features.name: Embouchure (Meri/Kari)
features.description: Shifts the pitch by up to 2 semitones down (meri) or up (kari).

features.name: Air Noise and Brightness
features.description: Air Noise blends unpitched breath noise against the tone; Brightness opens a low-pass filter on the tone.

features.name: Breath attack
features.description: During the attack (10 to 500 ms) the sound fades from breath noise into the tone; release runs from 0.1 to 2 s.

features.name: Vibrato
features.description: Sine vibrato with rate up to 10 Hz and depth up to 5% of the pitch.
